query: (max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"}) / scalar(quantile(0.5, kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu"})) > 0.5) or (max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"}) / scalar(quantile(0.5, kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory"})) > 0.5)
why: Containers whose CPU or memory request exceeds half the median node allocatable. Workloads that defeat bin packing and make Karpenter launch big nodes. The median rather than the smallest node is used because a 1-core smallest node would flag every 0.5-core request
